definitions.explanation: A picture printed from a carved block of wood, or the technique of making one. Ukiyo-e are the best-known Japanese examples.

examples.japanese: {木版画|もくはんが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{彫|ほ}る→彫る：00114_horu⟧。
⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{木版画|もくはんが}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made my New Year's cards as woodblock prints.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浮世絵|うきよえ}→浮世絵：13286_ukiyoe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{絵師|えし}→絵師：13878_eshi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{彫師|ほりし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{摺師|すりし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分業|ぶんぎょう}→分業：09617_bungyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧{木版画|もくはんが}だ。
examples.english: Ukiyo-e are woodblock prints made by a division of labor among designers, carvers and printers.

notes:
{木|もく} (wood) + ⟦{版画|はんが}→版画：10582_hanga⟧ (print).
